observation.source_interface: MNCS Control protected runtime invoking Environment selected-checkout verification

outcome.error: authorized Environment workspace root is not canonical
outcome.interpretation: The Control sandbox's host-path symlink to its /workspace bind mount failed the Environment root equality check before Git registration and checkout identity could be verified.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Control workspace mount aliases block authorized branch checkout
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Resolve the host-path alias only when it targets the verified active /workspace mount, then retain Git worktree registration, branch, and identity checks.
